_about: NSE equity-segment TRADING holidays that fall on a weekday. Weekends are closed anyway and are not listed. Weekend special sessions (Budget Sunday, Diwali Muhurat) are deliberately not trading days: they are short or symbolic and automation must not run a full intraday day on them. autopilot-service/app/nse_holidays.json must stay identical to this file; backend/tests/test_market_calendar.py fails if they differ.

sources.2025: calendarlabs.com NSE market holidays 2025; weekday count 14 matches the independently reported total. Aug 27 (Ganesh Chaturthi) and the Oct 2 / Oct 21 / Oct 22 / Dec 25 closures corroborated separately. Not used by the backtest walk (it reaches back 90 trading days).
sources.2026: NSE-synced calendar (niftyscanner.in) cross-checked against groww.in and upstox.com. 15 Jan (Maharashtra municipal elections) was added by a later NSE circular and is confirmed by Business Standard, Upstox news and newsonair.gov.in; the retail lists written before it omit it.
